pet.title: Morning Glow
pet.description: Your pet stretches lazily as the morning sun hits the window. Take a few steps around your room to help it greet the day.

pet.title: Trail of Leaves
pet.description: Golden leaves swirl ahead of your pet’s paws. Step outside for a short walk and let them follow your path.

pet.title: Music Ripple
pet.description: A faint tune echoes through your pet’s world. Play a song fully or hum along — the ripples make the air sparkle.

pet.title: Creative Pawprints
pet.description: Your pet paws at a blank page curiously. Draw, write, or doodle something to leave your mark together.

dungeonMaster.title: Armor Inspection
dungeonMaster.description: Your warrior’s armor has a few scuffs from yesterday’s adventure. Take a moment to straighten up your space or tidy your desk — the armor shines brighter with your care.

dungeonMaster.title: Morning Drill
dungeonMaster.description: The warrior stretches and sharpens their stance. Stand up and do a few stretches or arm movements to join the morning drill.

dungeonMaster.title: Map Exploration
dungeonMaster.description: A new map of the enchanted forest appears. Take 5–10 minutes to read a short article, story, or notes — your warrior studies the terrain.

dungeonMaster.title: Trail March
dungeonMaster.description: The path ahead winds through the misty woods. Take a short walk around your home or outside, and let your warrior lead the way.
